headline: ONE 💼 THING 🧠 To SUCCEED 🏆 According To TOP 🧑‍💼 BOSSES
text:
BIG 📢 BOSSES 🧑‍💼 spill the TEA ☕ on the one SECRET 🔑 to getting HIRED 🪪 in this CROWDED 🏙️ workplace 🌍!! It's less about that PERFECT 📄 CV and way more about how you THINK 🧠 the QUESTIONS ❓ you ask and if you're ready to take a RISKY 💥 chance 🎲!! Six business FOUNDERS 🏗️ and leaders drop their hottest takes on what qualities they NOTICE 👀 most and the advice they'd give to anyone trying to get AHEAD 🏃‍♂️!! Charlotte Tilbury the beauty MOGUL 💄 says refusing to let others set LIMITS ⛔ on what she can do has DRIVEN 🚗 her whole career forward like a ROCKET 🚀!! "Nothing is impossible in life 🌟 it's only your own limitations you give yourself" she DROPS 🔥 while reminding everyone there will always be NAYSAYERS 🙉 who called her ideas MAD 🤪 but you gotta IGNORE 🙈 them completely bro!! Tilbury recommends treating setbacks not as MISTAKES ❌ but as fresh OPPORTUNITIES 🔄 to rethink and LEVEL 📈 UP your game!! "I don't think about mistakes I think mistakes are opportunities" she says while noting how the biggest CHALLENGES 🧗‍♀️ she faced turned her into a stronger business leader because challenge is opportunity and it leads you to greater PLACES 🏞️!!

Charlie Bowes-Lyon co-founder of that deodorant BRAND 🧴 WILD 🌲 says attitude matters way more than any perfect set of SKILLS 🛠️!! "For me it's 90% attitude and 10% skills as skills can be taught attitude can't" the WILD 🐺 DADDY reveals while wishing he'd realized earlier that even successful people don't always feel as CONFIDENT 💪 as they appear and everyone is faking it until they're making it!! If you find yourself at a job INTERVIEW 🗣️ Bowes-Lyon says it's really important to have a few questions at the end because candidates who say they have no questions rarely get the JOB 🏢!! One question he recommends asking the interviewer is what success in the job looks like so you don't look like a total NOOB 🧢!!

Marcia Kilgore the serial ENTREPRENEUR 💼 behind brands like Beauty Pie and Soap and Glory says CURIOSITY 🕵️‍♀️ is one of the main qualities she looks for when hiring new blood!! She values people who will roll their sleeves up 👕 ask lots of questions and think about how they can be USEFUL 🛠️ in every situation!! Kilgore also says good communication is CRUCIAL 📢 as she realized early on in her career that a lack of communication is often the reason things BREAKDOWN 💥!! Her advice to communicate well in the workplace is to listen to what's being asked and take a breath or five before RESPONDING 🗣️!! "Your response doesn't have to be immediate but it does have to be considered" she explains while building her beauty EMPIRE 👑!!

Anabel Kindersley CEO and co-owner of Neal's Yard Remedies says one of the best ways to build your skills is to keep saying YES 👍 to new opportunities even when it feels weird!! "Do everything and say yes to everything it might feel uncomfortable but do it anyway" she urges while explaining how that approach shaped her own varied career from child actress 🎭 to author 📖 and later moving into BUSINESS 🏪!! She adds that honesty really matters and you should be truthful about your experience and confident in what you can OFFER 🎁!! When hiring Kindersley says she looks for people with equal EQ as IQ valuing emotional intelligence alongside raw ABILITY 🧠!!

Charlie Nunn group chief executive of Lloyds Banking Group says curiosity resilience and an increasing willingness to think about how AI 🤖 tools can be used in the future are some of the skills he values most in his EMPLOYEES 👥!! He also really puts an emphasis on hiring people who are good at working in a TEAM 🤝 as at the heart of most jobs is the ability to work together in support of something much BIGGER 🌐!! His advice for building experience is to take on opportunities that are outside your comfort zone because if something feels risky try and do it as you'll learn more from it and it'll build breadth around your CV that you didn't have previously!! Nunn admits he was terrified about taking on retail roles earlier in his career but they gave him valuable LESSONS 📚!!

James Reed chairman and chief executive of recruitment company Reed says one of the biggest mistakes people make is thinking about what an employer can do for you rather than what you can offer in RETURN 🔄!! "The biggest mistake is thinking that the world owes you a living" he says and instead suggests you should ask yourself how am I the solution to an employer so you stop acting so entitled!! As AI is increasingly used in recruitment Reed says applicants need to think about how their skills are being picked up by technology as well as by a PERSON 👤!! "Try and mirror the job description with your skills and experiences in your application" he advises so that the match between what an employer is looking for and what you can offer is crystal CLEAR 📍!! He describes AI as a wonderful tool but says it should not replace your own judgement or voice the aim is for it to strengthen an application rather than expect it to do the work for you!!
